items.text: Stative verbs are those verbs which express a state or condition. They do not refer to a physical action. Sense and emotions like hear,  smell,  see,  love,  hate  etc  are  different  types  of  stative verbs.  Verbs  denoting  thoughts  and  opinions  include  know, believe,  think,  understand,  consider,  etc.  However,  these  verbs can't  be  used  in  (-ing  form)  for  example,  Hear,  Smell (Correct) and  Hearing,  Smelling  (Incorrect).  Hence,  'you  believe'  is  the most appropriate answer.
